title: Claimant app fixes: status polling, loss type, hidden picker, a11y
story: S2-EXP-03-1, S2-EXP-03-2, S2-EXP-03-3 (claimant app fixes + a11y warnings)
acceptance: status.js schedules polling without Illegal invocation: setTimeout bound to globalThis (or arrow wrappers); unit test in tests/unit/web/claimant/status.test.mjs covers default timers
app.js asks loss type first and startSession sends lossType in the POST body; selecting auto glass reaches the glass_location question
app.css has .ctl[hidden]{display:none}; Kestrel (English-only) tenant shows no language picker
The three t.todo tests in tests/ui/claimant.test.mjs are real passing tests (todo option removed)
node --test --disable-warning=ExperimentalWarning tests/ui/claimant.test.mjs tests/unit/web/claimant/ passes, with Chromium actually run via Playwright (not skipped)
a11y-check warnings for claimant start and status screens reduced to zero or each remaining one is justified in the result
brief: Intervention IMP-10: you MUST run the app in Chromium through the Playwright tests (resolve from /opt/node-tools/node_modules, browsers at /opt/pw-browsers; run with the node --test command) before declaring done; unit tests alone are not enough, these defects only showed in a real browser. Blockers are in org/hubs/experience.jsonl. (1) S2-EXP-03-1: src/web/claimant/status.js passes a plain object holding window.setTimeout and calls timers.setTimeout(...), which throws Illegal invocation. Bind to globalThis or default to arrow wrappers, keep injectable fakes for unit tests. (2) S2-EXP-03-2: app.js startSession never sends lossType, so loss-type question sets (auto glass, glass_location) are unreachable. Add a loss-type choice as the first step (accessible radio group or select, strings in strings.js), send lossType in the session start request, then render the returned question set. Check flow.js/chat.js for where the first question is rendered, and the existing channel decision claimant_web. Keep existing unit tests green and add one for lossType in the request. (3) S2-EXP-03-3: .ctl{display:flex} overrides the hidden attribute; add .ctl[hidden]{display:none} in app.css. (4) Run the a11y harness (tests/ui/a11y-harness.mjs, src/web/shared/a11y-check.js is read-only, not yours) and fix claimant warnings: labels, landmarks, focus, contrast, aria-live, etc. Flip the three todo tests in tests/ui/claimant.test.mjs to normal tests; they currently document the exact assertions. Do not touch src/web/csr, shared, package.json. Pitfall: tests must fail before the fix; verify by reasoning or briefly reverting. Report Chromium test output in your result.

verdicts.reason: All criteria verified: 31/31 pass with Chromium run, polling fix + unit test, loss type first and sent, .ctl[hidden], todos real, a11y warnings zero
